authorization.sourceMessage: In any case, it should either be one in our case, three if it is, and then ten, no re-running.
authorization.scope: Remove all new same-seed replay executions; preserve existing results. One, three or ten distinct seeds. Existing duration and research-only approval retained.

limitations: No repeatability replay is performed for new results. Original forecasts and flags remain intact. Agreement-dependent stopping is not an unbiased accuracy estimate. Exhausted and held contexts remain unfinished. No website release.
